raw:
Lewis Hamilton has the most Belgian Grand Prix wins at Spa in 2000–2025 among the races I could verify, with five.

| Driver | Spa wins found | Years |
|---|---|---|
| Lewis Hamilton | 5 | 2010, 2015, 2017, 2020, 2024 |
| Kimi Räikkönen | 4 | 2004, 2005, 2007, 2009 |
| Michael Schumacher | 2 | 2001, 2002 |
| Max Verstappen | 3 | 2021, 2022, 2023 |
| Sebastian Vettel | 3 | 2011, 2013, 2018 |

The other winners I found are one win each: Häkkinen (2000), Massa (2008), Button (2012), Ricciardo (2014), Rosberg (2016), Leclerc (2019) and Piastri (2025).

Two races, 2003 and 2006, returned no results in my searches, so their winners are unverified. Räikkönen would only tie Hamilton if he won both, which I can't confirm from the data.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
